verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability for viewing Elastic Observability's own spend, attributing that spend to teams or services, or alerting on usage spikes before billing. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: predictable storage costs via time series data streams, profiling to cut cloud spend, LLM cost tracking for monitored apps, and generic log-threshold alert rules a user could repurpose.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can see what my observability spend is, attribute it to teams or services, and catch usage spikes before the bill
